records.source: Watching a movie with mom sure brings me back!
records.translation: 和媽媽一起看電影，真讓我回想起以前！

records.source: (Pam and Penny are watching intently!)
records.translation: （潘姆和潘妮看得全神貫注！）

records.source: It's great to be able to do things as a family again!
records.translation: 能再次全家一起做些事情，真的很棒！

records.source: I'm looking forward to this! Jas and Vincent have been talking about it non-stop.
records.translation: 我很期待！賈斯和文森特一直不停談論這部電影。

records.source: Wow, it must be really hard leaving his family like that...$s
records.translation: 哇，就這樣離開家人一定非常難受……$s

records.source: Penny seems to be holding back some tears...
records.translation: 潘妮似乎在強忍淚水……

records.source: Thanks for taking me to this, I can't wait to tell the kids how good it was!
records.translation: 謝謝你帶我來看，我已經迫不及待想告訴孩子們這部電影有多棒！

records.source: Oh, '{0}'! This looks wholesome and fun!
records.translation: 喔，「{0}」！看起來既溫馨又有趣！

records.source: (Penny is smiling)
records.translation: （潘妮露出微笑）

records.source: I should totally bring the kids to see this sometime!
records.translation: 改天我一定要帶孩子們來看！

records.source: I'm excited, I'm in the mood for a good laugh!
records.translation: 好興奮，我正想痛快笑一場！

records.source: Did they just...?! Hahahaha!
records.translation: 他們剛才是不是……？！哈哈哈哈！

records.source: Whew, I've got a cramp from all that laughing...!
records.translation: 呼，笑得太厲害，都開始抽筋了……！

records.source: I'm a little nervous... I don't usually watch scary movies.$s
records.translation: 我有點緊張……平常不太看恐怖電影。$s

records.source: I can't look...$s
records.translation: 我不敢看……$s

records.source: I hope I don't have nightmares tonight!$s
records.translation: 希望今晚不會做惡夢！$s

records.source: Oooh, I've been dying to see this!
records.translation: 喔喔，我一直超想看這部電影！

records.source: Amazing! I hope they make another one!
records.translation: 太棒了！希望他們會推出續集！

records.source: Hey, I've heard some good things about this one!
records.translation: 嘿，我聽說這部電影風評很好！

records.source: That was great! Thanks for seeing this with me!
records.translation: 真的很棒！謝謝你陪我一起看！

records.source: I can't say I would've picked this one myself, but I'll try to keep an open mind...
records.translation: 我自己大概不會選這部，不過會儘量保持開放的心態……

records.source: Sorry if I ruined the movie for you, it just wasn't really my favorite...
records.translation: 如果破壞了你的觀影體驗，真的很抱歉，只是這部片實在不太合我的胃口……

records.source: Ooh, '{0}'! I saw this one with {2}!
records.translation: 喔，「{0}」！我和 {2} 一起看過這部！

records.source: I saw this with {2}, it was pretty good!
records.translation: 我和 {2} 一起看過，還挺不錯！

records.source: Hmm, I think {2} took me to see this...
records.translation: 嗯，我記得 {2} 曾帶我來看這部……

records.source: Hey, kid. Thanks for inviting me.
records.translation: 嘿，孩子。謝謝你邀請我。

records.source: Heh, that wasn't too bad!
records.translation: 嘿，還不算太差！

records.source: Psst... Hey, it's me, Krobus. Could you recognize me?$8#$b#If anyone approaches us, you do the talking, okay?$8
records.translation: 噓……嘿，是我，科羅布斯。認得出我嗎？$8#$b#如果有人靠近，就由你來說話，好嗎？$8

records.source: Not all shadow people are like that!$8
records.translation: 不是所有暗影族都那樣！$8

records.source: Krobus is stewing...
records.translation: 科羅布斯正在生悶氣……

records.source: I'm not used to wearing clothes... It's very uncomfortable!$8
records.translation: 我不習慣穿衣服……真的很不舒服！$8

records.source: *ahem*... Hello! I am very excited to be at the visual entertainment center and to consume the popped corn... just like you!$8#$b#*whisper*... how am I doing?$8
records.translation: *清喉嚨*……你好！我非常興奮能來到視覺娛樂中心，並且食用爆開的玉米……就和你一樣！$8#$b#*低語*……我表現得如何？$8

records.source: So, your species enjoys staring at flickering lights for hours on end? Very interesting...$8
records.translation: 原來你們這個物種喜歡連續幾小時盯著閃爍的光？非常有意思……$8

records.source: I sense an arcane power permeating this building tonight...
records.translation: 今晚，我感覺到一股奧術力量瀰漫在這棟建築中……

records.source: And to think... the layman has no idea that this is all raw, real footage!
records.translation: 想不到……外行人完全不知道這些全都是真實的原始影像！

records.source: There's a twinkle in Wizard's eye...
records.translation: 法師的眼中閃爍著光芒……

records.source: For those aware of the esoteric mysteries, that had deep significance...
records.translation: 對知曉祕傳奧祕的人而言，其中蘊含著深刻意義……

records.source: You pulled me from my studies for *this*?
records.translation: 你把我從研究中拉出來，就是為了*這個*？

records.source: The newspaper gave this one '5 stars', so I'm willing to give it a go.
records.translation: 報紙給了這部片「五星」評價，所以我願意看看。

records.source: Heh! That was actually pretty good! Thanks for inviting me.
records.translation: 嘿！其實還挺不錯！謝謝你邀請我。

records.source: Hmph... Theaters aren't like they used to be... But the picture might be good enough.
records.translation: 哼……電影院早就不像以前了……不過這部片也許還過得去。

records.source: Heh. Compared to most movies these days, it wasn't bad.$h
records.translation: 嘿。和現在大多數電影相比，還不算差。$h

records.source: Hmph... I'll take a nap during this one.
records.translation: 哼……這部片我就拿來睡覺吧。

records.source: Shameful! The trash they pass for 'movies' these days...
records.translation: 真不像話！現在這種垃圾也敢稱作「電影」……

records.source: This one's supposed to be pretty funny, I'm looking forward to it.
records.translation: 聽說這部片相當好笑，我很期待。

records.source: Hah! I really liked it. But I dunno if I could survive on gluten pucks like that.
records.translation: 哈！我真的很喜歡。不過要只靠那種麵筋餅生存，我可不確定受不受得了。

records.source: I've been wanting to see this one for a while. Thanks for the ticket, @!
records.translation: 我想看這部片已經有一陣子了。@，謝謝你的票！

records.source: That was great! My legs are still tingling with the excitement.
records.translation: 真是太棒了！我的雙腿還因為興奮而陣陣發麻。

records.source: Hey, I'm pretty excited to see a movie! I'm gonna need a snack, though...
records.translation: 嘿，想到要看電影，我還挺興奮！不過得先來份點心……

records.source: Hey, that was pretty good. Thanks for inviting me to this, @.
records.translation: 嘿，還挺不錯。@，謝謝你邀請我來看。

records.source: This movie seems kind of nerdy, but I'll give it a shot.
records.translation: 這部電影看起來有點書呆子氣，不過我願意試試。

records.source: I can't tell if that was boring, or if I'm just not smart enough to understand it...$s
records.translation: 我分不出來是電影太無聊，還是自己不夠聰明所以看不懂……$s

records.source: Before this theater came to town, I hadn't seen a movie in twenty years!$h
records.translation: 在這間電影院開到鎮上之前，我已經二十年沒看過電影了！$h

records.source: I loved it... now you know why '{0}' is considered a classic.
records.translation: 我非常喜歡……現在你明白「{0}」為什麼被視為經典了。

records.source: It's very kind of you to invite an old lady to the movies.$h
records.translation: 你願意邀請一位老太太來看電影，真是太貼心了。$h

records.source: I'm glad they're still making decent movies... I had a lot of fun!
records.translation: 很高興現在還有人拍得出像樣的電影……我看得很開心！

records.source: I've never been a fan of scary movies, but I'll try to keep an open mind.
records.translation: 我從來不喜歡恐怖電影，不過會儘量保持開放的心態。

records.source: Is it over yet?$s
records.translation: 結束了嗎？$s
